title: Correlation immunity of a parity function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $k$ be a natural number. If $|S|=k+1$, then every nonempty coordinate set of size at most $k$ has Fourier coefficient of absolute value at most zero for the real-valued parity function associated to $S$; equivalently, all such coefficients vanish.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
